violations.text: Raw animal foods (chicken) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (eggrolls) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Raw food items were moved to bottom shelf. No evidence of contamination of RTE food present during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, ice machine, and grinder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Grinder, can opener, and ice machine were cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Ice was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Knives were stored on an unclean surface (between prep tables) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Knives were washed, rinsed, and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The bottom shelf of the prep table located by the rice warmers was not in good repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2026
The condensate from the wall air conditioner units is draining into a sink. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The hood system filters were observed with an excess of debris. Hood system filters must be maintained clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

Steel wool was observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Steel wool was removed at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils can opener were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener was moved to the 3-bay sink at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, cooked shrimp was placed hot and covered in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Per PIC, shrimp was cooked 1 hour prior to inspection. Shrimp was moved to sheets pans. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025

ROP tuna filets were observed thawing with the ROP packaging still intact. Tuna filets were observed at 40 DF and were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of rice. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025

The cutting boards in the prep unit area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 04/14/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in shelves have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025

The floors behind the cook line have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2025
The hood system was observed with an accumulation of grease build up. Hood systems must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2025

Food items was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/10/2024

The floor at the end of the cook line has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 01/17/2024
